collision_pairs.discriminator: Choose BW-F02 when the first persuasive job is reducing safety/wrong-choice anxiety through boundaries, suitability and reassurance. Choose BW-F06 when the first job is proving that a mechanism/process is credible and causally capable of producing the desired change.
collision_pairs.human_review_trigger: both safety reassurance and mechanism proof are co-equal before CTA

collision_pairs.discriminator: Choose BW-F05 when the customer already accepts the category and needs routing among options. Choose BW-F08 when the customer first needs to understand the category, self-place and gain permission for a low-commitment next step before option routing.
collision_pairs.human_review_trigger: category acceptance is unclear from company/customer truth

collision_pairs.discriminator: Choose BW-F01 when imagined experience/atmosphere itself carries desire. Choose BW-F04 when maker, human technique, provenance or how-it-is-made evidence is indispensable to trust and meaning.
collision_pairs.human_review_trigger: sensory experience and provenance are equally central and neither can be subordinated

collision_pairs.discriminator: Choose BW-F03 when premium/aspirational authority and authored visual status lead. Choose BW-F04 when authority must resolve into human/material provenance and craft process.
collision_pairs.human_review_trigger: premium authority is inseparable from a founder/maker narrative

collision_pairs.discriminator: Choose BW-F07 only when locality/community/ongoing nearby relationship materially changes the buying decision. Human warmth alone is not enough. Choose BW-F04 when human technique/provenance matters but locality is incidental.
collision_pairs.human_review_trigger: locality is present in copy but its decision relevance is not evidenced

collision_pairs.discriminator: Choose BW-F06 when method credibility is the gating question. Choose BW-F08 when understanding what the category is and whether it fits precedes trust in the mechanism.
collision_pairs.human_review_trigger: educational explanation and process proof are co-equal in the customer journey

dimension_findings.interpretation: Weak-alone dimensions remain useful modifiers but should not independently decide a Family because they appear at high values across multiple families. Decision-state context is required.

secondary_influence_finding: Secondary influence is structurally necessary, not an edge-case escape hatch. All 16 validation cases have at least one credible secondary/alternative influence, while the dominant family remains identifiable by the first persuasive job.
taxonomy_verdict_basis: No validation case requires a ninth family. The observed ambiguity is explainable by explicit boundary rules between existing families.
